subject: Request: SDR to AE conversions + Senior SE headcount for Q3 coverage
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDR to AE conversions + Senior SE headcount for Q3 coverage

Team —

Quick ask ahead of the weekly GTM cadence: we have an immediate coverage gap in the Mountain & Central mid-market segments that is starting to show in pipeline velocity (few customers slipping to next quarter). After triage with the regional SDR leads and account teams, I recommend the following minimal changes for Q3 to preserve conversion rates and upcoming renewals:

- Convert 2 existing SDR FTEs (both in West region) to AE roles (level L2 → AE1). These are internal reclassifications — no external posting required for one of them.
- Add 1 Senior Solutions Engineer (SE4) focused on mid-market product demos and early-POC acceleration (North America headcount).

Rationale: the SDR→AE conversions reduce ramp time for active accounts (two SDRs are already performing above SDR quota and have AE-level opportunity ownership in practice). The SE hire is the bigger blocker for closing 6 mid-market opportunities where technical depth is demanded.

Budget/comp impact (high level):
- Net incremental headcount this quarter: +1 (SE) — conversion is headcount-neutral for the two SDRs.
- Estimated comp delta (annual run-rate): +$180k gross (SE salary + equity) before offsets. See attached comp-band-summary.pdf and the HC proposal workbook for breakouts.

Ask: please confirm approval to proceed with the following by EOD Monday so Talent can post/submit reqs and RevOps can model cost center changes:
1) Approve 2 SDR→AE conversions (we can stagger starts if needed).
2) Approve 1 FT Senior SE (hire target start: 08/03/2026).
3) Confirm funding source (Q3 Opex vs reallocate from slower regions).

Attachments: 20260509-hc-proposal.xlsx, comp-band-summary.pdf

Thanks — I know this is tight but pipeline shows we need action to prevent deal slippage.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDR to AE conversions + Senior SE headcount for Q3 coverage

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. I support the ask in principle. A couple of operating notes before final approval:

- Approve conversion of 1 SDR → AE now (we have slack in the AE hiring plan to absorb one), second SDR conversion I want to see two weeks of sustained pipeline velocity improvement before converting.
- Approve the Senior SE hire headcount-wise; please confirm proposed level and rough comp band so I can align with Finance. Karthik, can you confirm SE4 is the right level for the scope?
- We should try to offset some of the SE cost via a delayed hire in EMEA (we have a hiring freeze in that region that might create a small savings window). Markus — can RevOps model that offset?

If we get a modeled plan from RevOps and a formal cost approval from Finance by EOD Tuesday, I can sign off to Talent to post and start interviews.

Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Folks —

I've started a quick RevOps model and attached a stripped-down headcount file: revops-hc-model.csv. A few questions/assumptions I need validated before I can provide the formal numbers to Finance:

1) Funding source: are we charging this to the US Sales Opex (Q3) or do we reallocate from the international hiring envelope (EMEA) as Marissa suggested? That changes the approval flow.
2) Cost centers: provide the cost center numbers for the new SE req (or confirm it sits on 4102 - NA Sales).
3) Compensation bands: the comp-band-summary.pdf lists target OTE for AE1 and salary range for SE4 — confirm final target comp (I can model conservative, median, aggressive).

If we aim to close on paper by Tuesday, I recommend: conservative SE comp (median), convert the first SDR immediate with AE onboarding in mid-June, and hold the second conversion pending the velocity metrics Marissa requested. That keeps the near-term budget impact smaller and buys us velocity data.

Markus

Redwood Inference

Hannah / team —

Supportive of the single Senior SE hire; scope looks right for SE4 given the expected POC depth and integrations (we'll need someone with API/infra experience). A few operational notes from the SE org side:

- Preferred split: remote-first hire with quarterly travel budget for customer workshops (keeps comp band competitive without on-site premium).
- Interview loop: please include an AE manager, a solutions engineering manager (me), and a technical lead from product. Greenwood Talent can pre-screen for infra-experience but we should reserve final round for live demo.
- Ramp plan: target 60% booking-support capacity by month 3, full independent PoC ownership by month 5.

I'll draft a short job spec and propose an SE4 salary target: base $170k - $190k with typical equity band (see comp-band-summary.pdf). If RevOps can model the median band, we should be fine.
